name: rud-dashboard-workspace
description: Monorepo for rud-dashboard: a headless layout engine on npm, and a shadcn registry that ships the UI as editable source.
author: Ofir Rubin

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=rud-dashboard && npm run registry:build
scripts.registry:serve: npm run registry:build && npx --yes http-server public -p 4499 --cors -s
